title: Fishes
statementMd:
While Grisha was celebrating New Year with Ded Moroz, Misha gifted Sasha a small rectangular pond of size $*n* × *m*$, divided into cells of size $1 × 1$, inhabited by tiny evil fishes (no more than one fish per cell, otherwise they'll strife!).

The gift bundle also includes a square scoop of size $*r* × *r*$, designed for fishing. If the lower-left corner of the scoop-net is located at cell $(*x*, *y*)$, all fishes inside the square $(*x*, *y*)...(*x* + *r* - 1, *y* + *r* - 1)$ get caught. Note that the scoop-net should lie completely inside the pond when used.

Unfortunately, Sasha is not that skilled in fishing and hence throws the scoop randomly. In order to not frustrate Sasha, Misha decided to release $*k*$ fishes into the empty pond in such a way that the expected value of the number of caught fishes is as high as possible. Help Misha! In other words, put $*k*$ fishes in the pond into distinct cells in such a way that when the scoop-net is placed into a random position among $(*n* - *r* + 1)·(*m* - *r* + 1)$ possible positions, the average number of caught fishes is as high as possible.

## Input

The only line contains four integers $*n*, *m*, *r*, *k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *r* ≤ *min*(*n*, *m*)$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(*n*·*m*, 10^{5})$).

## Output

Print a single number — the maximum possible expected number of caught fishes.

You answer is considered correct, is its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 9}$. Namely, let your answer be $*a*$, and the jury's answer be $*b*$. Your answer is considered correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70655c3293cb3fc998c4b6a9baf73f2894b413de.png).

## Note

In the first example you can put the fishes in cells $(2, 1)$, $(2, 2)$, $(2, 3)$. In this case, for any of four possible positions of the scoop-net (highlighted with light green), the number of fishes inside is equal to two, and so is the expected value.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f1262df2acb0bb62b0c4b246249aae30e7f57252.png)
statementZhMd:
在格里沙和杰德·莫罗兹一起庆祝新年时，米沙送给萨沙一个大小为 $*n* × *m*$ 的小型矩形池塘。池塘被划分为大小为 $1 × 1$ 的方格，里面生活着邪恶的小鱼（每个方格中至多有一条鱼，否则它们会争斗！）。

礼物中还包括一个用于捕鱼的大小为 $*r* × *r*$ 的方形捞网。如果捞网的左下角位于方格 $(*x*, *y*)$，那么方格范围 $(*x*, *y*)...(*x* + *r* - 1, *y* + *r* - 1)$ 内的所有鱼都会被捞到。注意，使用捞网时，它必须完全位于池塘内部。

遗憾的是，萨沙并不擅长捕鱼，因此他会随机扔出捞网。为了不让萨沙失望，米沙决定以一种使捞到鱼的数量的期望值尽可能大的方式，将 $*k*$ 条鱼放入空池塘中。请帮助米沙！换句话说，需要将 $*k*$ 条鱼放入池塘中的不同方格，使得当捞网从 $(*n* - *r* + 1)·(*m* - *r* + 1)$ 个可能的位置中随机选择一个放置时，捞到鱼的平均数量尽可能大。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含四个整数 $*n*, *m*, *r*, *k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *r* ≤ *min*(*n*, *m*)$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(*n*·*m*, 10^{5})$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个数，即可能的捞到鱼的数量的最大期望值。

如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则认为答案正确。也就是说，设你的答案为 $*a*$，评测程序的答案为 $*b*$，当且仅当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70655c3293cb3fc998c4b6a9baf73f2894b413de.png) 时，你的答案被认为是正确的。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，可以将鱼放在方格 $(2, 1)$、$(2, 2)$、$(2, 3)$ 中。此时，对于捞网的四个可能位置中的任意一个（图中以浅绿色标出），捞网内的鱼数量都等于 2，因此期望值也是 2。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f1262df2acb0bb62b0c4b246249aae30e7f57252.png)
